name: package-only-unread-node-command
description: A package whose only Node evidence would be a script that runs node behind env --frobnicate, an option the env reader does not handle, holds none for program.36: the command is not understood, so its JavaScript resolves as a bundler does, the extensionless relative specifier names its file and raises no unresolved-specifier note. The held text names index.js, which the static word index.js already roots with all it exports; the manifest is noted because an option no table lists may make the command run any file.
